ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring For Energy environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe from and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
